traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements for docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md are implemented and verified: - The rule automatically inserts a file-level @supports placeholder template with clear TODO guidance when missing, controlled by autoFixTestTemplate (default true). - Malformed [REQ-XXX] prefixes in it/test names are normalized for spacing, delimiter, casing, and bracket vs. parenthesis forms when a recognizable REQ ID is already present; missing prefixes only produce errors, not auto-fixes. - Auto-fixes are restricted to comments and string literal values, preserving existing formatting, quoting, and test implementation semantics; fixes are only offered when the transformation is unambiguous and safe. - Configuration options and behavior are documented in user-docs/api-reference.md, explicitly calling out Story 021.0’s auto-fix capabilities. - Dedicated tests in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts cover both template insertion and each prefix normalization scenario, including the no-inference case where no fix is produced for entirely missing prefixes; these tests all pass in the full Jest suite.
Based on this concrete implementation, test coverage, and documentation, the story is fully satisfied.
